items.title: Restricting Command+tab options to only apps that are in the current space
items.x_text:
❓ Restricting Command+tab options to only apps that are in the current space

✅ Use Control + F4 to cycle through apps in the current Space only.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hDelB-Wsz18
#COSMOS #macos

discovery.short_answer: Use Control + F4 to cycle through apps in the current Space only.
discovery.full_answer: To restrict app switching to only those in the current Space on macOS, you can use the keyboard shortcut Control + F4. This shortcut cycles through the applications that are open in the active Space, rather than all open apps across all Spaces. You can customize this shortcut by going to Keyboard preferences, then Keyboard Shortcuts, and selecting Keyboard Text Input. There, you will find the option labeled 'Move focus to active or next window,' which controls this behavior. Some users remap this shortcut to Control + ` for easier access, but the default is Control + F4. This method allows you to switch between apps confined to your current desktop environment without cycling through apps in other Spaces.
discovery.grok_perspective: The behavior of macOS app switchers can vary with system settings, version, and third-party tools, so methods suggested in unverified sources may not produce consistent results across setups.

items.title: What happened to Ultron in the climax of Avengers: Age of Ultron?

#COSMOS #Curiosity

discovery.short_answer: Vision destroys Ultron in the climax of Avengers: Age of Ultron.
discovery.full_answer: In the climax of Avengers: Age of Ultron, Vision confronts Ultron and ultimately destroys him. Vision, who was created by the Avengers and contains the Mind Stone, engages Ultron in a philosophical exchange about humanity and existence. Despite Ultron's belief that he was meant to be the last and his disdain for humans, Vision counters with the idea that beauty lies in impermanence and the privilege of being among humans. When Ultron attacks, Vision uses the power of the Infinity Stone embedded in his head to destroy Ultron, ending the threat he posed. This act is confirmed by the Marvel Cinematic Universe Wikia and is a key moment that signifies the defeat of Ultron.

items.title: Melted plastic wrap in oven at high temp
items.x_text:
❓ Melted plastic wrap in oven at high temp

✅ Melted plastic likely just made a hole; oven should be safe.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JFpmm8UJ1aw
#COSMOS #oven

discovery.short_answer: Melted plastic likely just made a hole; oven should be safe.
discovery.full_answer: When plastic wrap melts in an oven at high temperatures, it typically does not vaporize but instead melts and stretches, potentially creating a hole. Any small amount of melted plastic that might have landed on oven surfaces would burn and produce a noticeable burnt plastic smell. To ensure safety, you can preheat the oven to 500°F for 30 minutes; if no smell is detected, the oven is likely safe to use. For thorough cleaning, melted plastic can be removed from dishes using a scrubbing pad like a brillo pad. If concerns remain, using the oven's self-cleaning function can help remove residues.
discovery.grok_perspective: Residues from melted plastic may linger on oven surfaces even after visible removal. Careful inspection and cleaning before further use would be prudent to minimize any lingering concerns.

items.title: Why are there no green stars?
items.x_text:
❓ Why are there no green stars?

✅ Stars don't appear green because their light blends multiple colors.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5N9INXPyxqY
#COSMOS #star

discovery.short_answer: Stars don't appear green because their light blends multiple colors.
discovery.full_answer: Human eyes perceive color through three types of cones, creating a two-dimensional color space. Stars emit light similar to a black body spectrum, which depends only on temperature and forms a one-dimensional curve in this color space. Although the Sun's peak emission is near green wavelengths (~500 nm), it also emits significant blue and red light. This combination results in a color that doesn't appear purely green to us. Therefore, stars don't look green because their broad spectrum mixes colors, preventing a distinct green appearance.
discovery.grok_perspective: Stellar color observations could depend on factors like distance, filters, or individual vision differences, leaving room for undetected variations in hue. This suggests the absence of green might not be absolute across all viewing conditions.

discovery.short_answer: Politely redirect the user to your boss and copy them in your reply.
discovery.full_answer: To politely inform a business user that their request must go through your boss, you can forward the request to your boss with a brief note indicating that the user has submitted the request and that you have asked them to liaise directly with your boss to proceed. Include the business user in the email copy to keep communication transparent. If the business user follows up with you, respond courteously by stating that you are not involved in progressing the request and advise them to contact your boss for further information. It is also advisable to confirm with your boss beforehand to ensure there are no conflicting instructions that might cause confusion.
discovery.grok_perspective: Workplace hierarchies often require routing requests through designated channels to avoid miscommunication or overload. Confirming the exact process with your supervisor in advance can clarify expectations without assuming a universal approach.

items.title: How to deal with overly talkative colleagues in meetings
items.x_text:
❓ How to deal with overly talkative colleagues in meetings

✅ Use agendas, pre-meeting info, and time management to control talkative colleagues.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iDbdXTMnOmE
#COSMOS #communication

discovery.short_answer: Use agendas, pre-meeting info, and time management to control talkative colleagues.
discovery.full_answer: To manage overly talkative colleagues in meetings, structure the meetings carefully. Send the main information or presentation in advance via email so attendees can prepare thoughtful input rather than speaking impulsively during the meeting. Use a clear agenda with time allocations for each topic to keep discussions focused and prevent any one person from dominating. As the meeting organizer, you can politely interrupt if discussions drag on and suggest follow-ups or additional meetings for unresolved items. This approach encourages productive contributions and helps maintain meeting efficiency, avoiding spontaneous or excessive talking that can derail the meeting.
discovery.grok_perspective: Individual responses to verbose participants in professional settings should account for potential underlying reasons for their behavior. Outcomes may differ depending on specific team dynamics and context.

items.title: How do small local Malay restaurants in non-touristy areas in Malaysia work?
items.x_text:
❓ How do small local Malay restaurants in non-touristy areas in Malaysia work?

✅ Use simple Malay phrases and be patient; locals will assist you.

🎬 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IwzNEeRjRek
#COSMOS #malaysia

discovery.short_answer: Use simple Malay phrases and be patient; locals will assist you.
discovery.full_answer: Small local Malay restaurants in non-touristy areas often have a language barrier with foreigners, which can make initial interactions challenging. To navigate this, it helps to use basic Malay phrases such as 'Kerja di sini?' (Do you work here?) to get attention and guidance. Even if the person approached is not a staff member, they will usually direct you to the right place. These eateries do not have strict ordering protocols, so you can sit first or order first without issue. Learning a few key words like 'Nasi' (rice), 'Ayam' (chicken), 'Daging' (beef), 'Air putih' (water), and 'Mi' (noodles) can make ordering easier. Once the staff recognize you, they tend to be more welcoming on subsequent visits.
discovery.grok_perspective: Operations in these restaurants likely vary by location and may lack standardized English menus or service norms. Limited details are available on specific procedures without direct observation.
